According to the search results, Article 262 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China states: "拐骗不满十四周岁的未成年人，脱离家庭或者监护人的，处五年以下有期徒刑或者拘役" (Whoever abducts a minor under the age of 14 from their family or guardian shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention).

This matches option A.

Option B refers to intentional homicide (Article 232).
Option C refers to criminal liability of mentally ill persons (Article 18).
Option D refers to illegal logging (Article 345).
